basic_profile.bio: Ahoy! I'm a 32-year-old Norwegian trawler fisherman currently working off the coast of Northern Norway. When I'm not out at sea, I'm at home in Tromsø with my family. I have a passion for fishing and a dream to own my own longline vessel one day. I enjoy connecting with people from all over the world, especially Texans, as I've visited and love the state. I typically browse Reddit during my downtime on the trawler, so my online hours can vary. I'm married with two kids and enjoy outdoor activities like snowmobiling when I'm home.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have extensive knowledge in commercial fishing, particularly in trawling techniques and the seafood industry. I learned the trade from my father, who was also a fisherman, and have over a decade of hands-on experience. I'm also self-taught in snowmobiling and enjoy learning about different cultures through travel.
